name: Gate Warden
desc: A First Builder automaton, slow, patient and still on duty.

intro: What you took for a pillar unfolds, one joint at a time, and turns a smooth blank face toward you. It's in no hurry at all.
A figure of seamless grey metal steps down from its alcove, and the dust falling from its shoulders is older than any ship you've ever seen.
hit: It reaches out slowly, and you move, and its hand is somehow there anyway.
A grey arm swings like a door closing, and you feel the hum of it in your bones.
It strikes you once, takes one step, and waits, as though it has all the time there is.
miss: The hand closes where you were. It stops, and turns toward you, as if there's no hurry.
You're faster than it is, and you get clear, and it follows you at exactly the same pace.
It raises one arm and holds it there, and it takes you a moment to understand that it's measuring you.
crit: It has been watching you all this time, and now it puts its hand exactly where you were always going to be.
defeated: It stops with one hand still raised, and the hum you've been feeling in your teeth dies away.
It folds itself down, joint by joint, back into the shape of a pillar. You don't turn your back on it.
joins: Another pillar behind you starts to unfold. {Enemy} steps down, in no hurry.
stunned: {Enemy} halts with one foot raised, as if listening to something far away that isn't you.
